tasks.title: Apply Copper-based Fungicide
tasks.details: Spray copper hydroxide or copper sulfate solution on affected plants. Mix 2-3 tablespoons per gallon of water. Apply in early morning or late evening.

tasks.title: Remove Infected Leaves
tasks.details: Carefully remove and dispose of severely infected leaves. Do not compost them. Wash hands and tools after handling.

tasks.title: Second Fungicide Application
tasks.details: Apply second round of copper-based fungicide. Ensure thorough coverage of both leaf surfaces.

tasks.title: Check Plant Recovery
tasks.details: Inspect plants for new growth and reduced symptoms. Look for healthy new leaves without spots.

tasks.title: Final Treatment Application
tasks.details: Apply final preventive treatment. Continue monitoring for 2 more weeks.
